title: On the large-time behavior of strong solutions to the generalized compressible Navier-Stokes-Korteweg system in 2D and 3D for arbitrarily large initial data
summary: In this paper, we establish the global existence and large-time behavior of strong solutions for the two- and three-dimensional periodic compressible Navier-Stokes-Korteweg system with arbitrarily large initial data $(ρ_0,u_0)\in H^3\times H^2$. The viscosity coefficients satisfy the BD relation $μ(ρ)=νρ^α$ and $λ(ρ)=2ν(α-1)ρ^α$, while the capillarity coefficient is given by $κ(ρ)=\varepsilon^2α^2ρ^{2α-3}$.
